description:
The Skill Development Training Scheme in Manipur is a significant initiative by the Government of India aimed at enhancing the employability of youth in the state. 

This scheme was launched in 2015 under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The program is part of the broader Skill India Mission which was initiated in 2015. 

The main objective of the Skill Development Training Scheme in Manipur is to provide skill training to the youth of the state. 

The scheme aims to train around 1 million youth in various skills by the year 2025. 

It focuses on sectors that have high employment potential such as agriculture, manufacturing, services, and information technology. 

The specific goal is to reduce unemployment rates among the youth in Manipur, which stood at approximately 16.5% in 2020. 

The scheme also aims to promote entrepreneurship among the youth by providing them with the necessary skills and knowledge. 

Beneficiaries of the scheme receive training in various trades and skills that are aligned with market demands. 

The training programs are designed to be flexible and can be conducted in both urban and rural areas. 

Participants in the scheme are provided with a stipend of ₹500 per month during the training period. 

The training duration varies depending on the trade but typically ranges from 3 to 6 months. 

Upon successful completion of the training, participants receive a certificate that is recognized by the Government of India. 

This certification enhances their employability and provides them with a competitive edge in the job market. 

Eligibility for the Skill Development Training Scheme includes youth aged between 18 to 35 years. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for the scheme. 

However, candidates must be residents of Manipur and should not be enrolled in any other skill development program. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

They need to fill out an application form providing personal details and information about their educational background. 

Required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhaar card, proof of residence, and a passport-sized photograph. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the implementing authorities. 

Candidates are then informed about the training centers where they can undergo the training. 

The training centers are established in collaboration with various organizations and institutions across the state. 

The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Employment and Craftsmen Training in Manipur. 

This department is responsible for coordinating the skill development initiatives in the state. 

They work closely with various training partners to ensure quality training is provided. 

The scheme is funded by the Government of India, with additional support from the state government. 

The government allocates a budget of approximately ₹50 crores annually for skill development initiatives in Manipur. 

This funding is utilized for training programs, infrastructure development, and providing stipends to participants. 

Disbursement of stipends occurs monthly during the training period. 

The Skill Development Training Scheme also emphasizes the importance of soft skills training. 

This includes communication skills, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities. 

These soft skills are crucial for improving the overall employability of the participants. 

The scheme also encourages the establishment of self-help groups and cooperatives among trained individuals. 

This promotes entrepreneurship and self-employment opportunities in the state. 

The government conducts regular assessments and evaluations of the training programs. 

This ensures that the training provided is relevant and meets the needs of the job market. 

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the quality of training. 

The scheme also collaborates with various industries to facilitate job placements for trained individuals. 

Job fairs are organized periodically to connect employers with skilled youth. 

The first job fair under this scheme was held in December 2016. 

It saw participation from over 50 companies and provided job opportunities to more than 1,000 candidates. 

The Skill Development Training Scheme has shown positive outcomes since its inception. 

As of 2023, over 20,000 youth have been trained under this initiative in Manipur. 

The government aims to increase this number significantly in the coming years. 

The scheme has also contributed to reducing the skill gap in various sectors in Manipur. 

It has empowered youth by providing them with the necessary skills to secure employment. 

The initiative aligns with the national objective of creating a skilled workforce in India. 

The government is committed to enhancing the skill development ecosystem in Manipur. 

This includes improving infrastructure and increasing the number of training centers. 

The Skill Development Training Scheme is a vital step towards achieving economic growth and development in the state. 

It plays a crucial role in transforming the lives of youth by providing them with opportunities for a better future. 

The scheme not only focuses on skill development but also on holistic development. 

This includes fostering a sense of self-reliance among the youth of Manipur. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the scheme through various outreach programs. 

This ensures that more youth are informed and can take advantage of the opportunities available. 

The Skill Development Training Scheme in Manipur is a comprehensive initiative aimed at empowering the youth. 

It is a crucial part of the government's strategy to address unemployment and promote sustainable development. 

The scheme reflects the commitment of the Government of India towards building a skilled and employable workforce. 

The future of the Skill Development Training Scheme looks promising as it continues to evolve and adapt to changing market needs. 

The government remains focused on achieving its targets and improving the livelihoods of the youth in Manipur. 

This initiative is a testament to the government's dedication to fostering skill development and entrepreneurship in the region.
